intro.data: The goal is the same kind of thing as the start. You still need a step between them — one that changes nothing. The Pass Through machine returns a thing as itself.
intro.alchemy: The goal is the same kind of thing as the start. You still need a step between them — one that changes nothing. The Preserve apparatus returns a material as itself.
intro.spellcraft: The goal is the same kind of thing as the start. You still need a step between them — one that changes nothing. The Echo rune returns an essence as itself.
intro.abstract: The goal is the same object as the start. You still need a step between them — one that changes nothing. The Identity process returns an object as itself.

goal.data: Wire the start through the do-nothing machine back to the goal of the same type.
goal.alchemy: Wire the start through the do-nothing apparatus back to the goal of the same type.
goal.spellcraft: Wire the start through the do-nothing rune back to the goal of the same type.
goal.abstract: Wire the start through id_A back to the goal A.

description.data: Returns the data unchanged (Raw CSV → Raw CSV).
Raw CSV → Clean Table (changes the type — wrong goal).
description.alchemy: Ore → Ingot (changes the type — wrong goal).
description.spellcraft: Spark → Flame (changes the type — wrong goal).
description.abstract: A → B (changes the type — wrong goal).

afterSuccess.data: You used a step that changes nothing — and it still counts as a step. A do-nothing process from a thing back to itself is called identity.
afterSuccess.alchemy: You used a step that changes nothing — and it still counts as a step. A do-nothing process from a material back to itself is called identity.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: You used a step that changes nothing — and it still counts as a step. A do-nothing working from an essence back to itself is called identity.
afterSuccess.abstract: You used a step that changes nothing — and it still counts as a step. A do-nothing arrow from an object back to itself is called identity.

reveal.summary: Every object has an identity step from itself to itself. It does nothing to the thing passing through, yet it is a perfectly valid process.
reveal.moreFormal: For each object A there is an identity morphism id_A : A → A. It is the canonical do-nothing arrow on A. Why it matters under composition is the subject of the next chapter.
